name: Fluence Energy, Inc.
summary: Fluence is a pure-play global provider of grid-scale battery energy storage products (Smartstack, Gridstack Pro), services/O&M, and asset-optimization software (Fluence OS, Mosaic, Nispera). Formed in January 2018 as a 50/50 Siemens–AES joint venture and IPO'd in October 2021, it remains Nasdaq-listed (Siemens held 38.9% as of Dec 2025; AES and Siemens sold a combined $420M of shares in a May 2026 secondary; AES itself was reportedly being taken private by GIP/BlackRock for ~$38B). Its US differentiation is a domestic-content supply chain — US-made cells (AESC Tennessee) and Utah module assembly qualifying customers for the IRA domestic-content ITC bonus.
ecosystemRole: One of the two leading Western system integrators (with Tesla) in a market now dominated by Chinese vertically integrated players — ranked #7 in Wood Mackenzie's first Global BESS Integrator Comprehensive Ranking (July 2026) as annual global installs passed 100 GW. Cumulative deployed capacity 6.8 GW (Sep 2025, +36% YoY); record $6.4B backlog by June 2026, boosted by master supply agreements with two major hyperscalers and AI/data-center demand.

productsAndServices.name: Smartstack (newest grid-scale platform)
productsAndServices.description: Modular AC-based platform unveiled February 2025 — a centralized 'Smart Skid' (PCS/controls) plus swappable battery pods replacing the 20-ft container paradigm, ~30% denser than existing AC systems; first deliveries from late 2025. A high-density 10 MWh variant followed in June 2026 (2/4/6/8-hour durations, ~680 MWh/acre, up to 40% balance-of-plant cost reduction).
highlights: Swappable pods enable augmentation/repowering without redesigning the site

productsAndServices.name: Gridstack Pro (current workhorse)
productsAndServices.description: Utility-scale DC-block line (Pro 1000/2000/5000); Gridstack Pro 5000 delivers up to 5.6 MWh per 20-ft enclosure on 530Ah AESC LFP cells. Anchor of the US domestic-content offering — e.g., a 2.2 GWh agreement with Excelsior Energy Capital deploying US-made systems from 2025.

productsAndServices.name: Fluence OS, Mosaic & Nispera (software)
productsAndServices.description: Fluence OS is the unified controls layer engineered with Smartstack as one hardware-software platform; Mosaic is AI-enabled automated bidding for wholesale markets; Nispera (acquired 2022) is renewables asset-performance management. Digital/recurring ARR reached $148M at FY2025-end with a $180M FY2026 target.

productsAndServices.name: Services & O&M
productsAndServices.description: Long-term service agreements, guarantees, maintenance, and fleet operations across the installed base; the company cites 99.3% availability across reviewed fleets ≥50 MW as a reliability benchmark for mission-critical (data-center) customers.

productsAndServices.name: US domestic-content supply chain
productsAndServices.description: Battery module production in Utah (from Sept 2024) with US-made cells from AESC's Tennessee plant; first domestic-content system shipments announced September 2025 — qualifying customers for the IRA domestic-content bonus credit and reducing China-tariff exposure. FY2026 shortfalls stem from this ramp's execution delays rather than demand.
highlights: Master supply agreements signed with two major hyperscalers in Q2 FY2026; record $1.44B order intake in Q3 FY2026

specs.label: Density

specs.label: Safety
specs.value: Passed large-scale fire testing; availability up to 99%

specs.label: Energy
